newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Construction wants India operations.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Construction wants India operations.

text.p: Volvo Construction Equipment (VCE), the construction machinery unit of Swedish automotive group AB Volvo, said on Monday it is evaluating different ways of getting established in India.
"India is a market with a high priority for us," VCE's president Bengt Ovlinger told Reuters.
"If our work to evaluate different ways to act is successful, we will make our decision this year."
India needs to develop its infrastructure and VCE needs to identify different roads into that market, he said.

"In Bangalore we have our own Volvo company," Ovlinger said. "To act through that company would be one way, but there are also other possibilities to combine that company with other roads in (to the market)."
Bangalore is developing into a Volvo centre. Volvo Trucks is to build a plant in the city and production is expected to start during the first quarter next year.
Volvo Buses has also reached agreement with state authorities to develop a public transportation system. The unit will also make buses in the city and invest about 100 million crowns there.
